mods.name: CNR Mod (Core)
mods.description: The core mod for Cops N Robbers. Redirects the game to the community LAN server, adds custom map loading, an in-game economy system, and a DLL mod loader that scans /sdcard/CNRMods/ on launch.

versions.changelog: Fixed: Close and Open Mod Manager buttons in the multiplayer block dialog were not clickable. A full-screen GUI.Button was consuming all touch events before the actual buttons could receive them.
Fixed: multiplayer block dialog buttons were not clickable because OnGUI was returning early (ecoPatched=false) before drawing the dialog. Dialog now draws before the ecoPatched guard.

Reworked multiplayer block: now checks mods at the MultiplayerSelect scene boundary instead of button interception. Bounces back to MainMenu and shows a dialog if CNRModManager reports required updates pending (missing or below minVersion). Fixes the case sensitivity bug where 'MultiplayerSelect' was being navigated to as 'MultiPlayerSelect'.

Fixed: multiplayer button block now checks CNRModManager.dll in addition to CNRMod.dll and CNRSettingsMod.dll. Fixed: EcoPatchMainMenu retries up to 30 times (2-frame intervals) if NGUI buttons aren't spawned on first pass. Fixed: hook==null no longer silently bypasses the block.

Fixed: weapon unlock flags (GLOCK21, MP5KA5, UZI, etc.) now sync correctly across devices. Fixed: equipped slot/skin/armor sync uses real timestamp so last-device-to-login wins instead of always overwriting.

Multi-device account support: one account can be linked to multiple Android devices. Display name syncs from server on login — the server's canonical name is applied to all linked devices. Game progression (weapon upgrade levels, skin/armor unlocks, equipped slots, level/XP) is now synced with the server via sync.php on every login. Claim now links a new device instead of migrating (old devices stay valid).
Account recovery now requires a password (6+ chars) AND a 4-8 digit PIN. Hash is bcrypt(password+pin) with no device ID — portable across devices and eliminates multi-match collisions.

Fixed: settings and mail buttons no longer show on top of the Mod Manager overlay. Reworked mod manager interop to use a direct static field (EconomyHook.ModManagerOpen) set by CNRModManager instead of cross-DLL reflection.

Intercepts the game's built-in multiplayer button. If CNRMod.dll or CNRSettingsMod.dll are not installed on the device, tapping Multiplayer now shows a dialog listing the missing mods instead of loading the server list.
Mail and settings icons are now embedded in the DLL — no longer need settings.png / mail.png on the device.
LAN server redirect. Custom map support. Economy hook. DLL mod loader with /sdcard/CNRMods/ scanner.
Initial public release.

mods.name: CNR Settings
mods.description: Adds a settings panel accessible from the main menu and in-game. Features draggable HUD element repositioning, ADS sensitivity slider, wide camera angle toggle, full keyboard and mouse binding support, and a player account system with password+PIN recovery.

versions.changelog: Account tab updated: Set Recovery Credentials now requires both a password (6+ chars) and a PIN (4-8 digits). Link Device (formerly Transfer Account) now requires name, password, and PIN matching the new auth scheme.
Full HUD drag-and-resize for all UI elements. KBM bindings with capture mode. ADS multiplier. Wide camera toggle (35deg / 70deg). Account PIN system.

mods.name: Mod Manager
mods.description: Browse, install, and manage DLL mods from online repositories. Tap a mod for its full description, version history, and changelogs. Supports multiple repos and works standalone even without CNR Mod installed.

versions.changelog: Connection error (UnknownHostException) now shows a friendly message instead of a raw Java exception.
Update banner (required installs, updates available, Install All, Quit Game) now appears in the Installed tab as well as the Browse tab.
Added HasRequiredPending static flag, read by CNRMod to gate multiplayer access. True when any mod with a minVersion is missing or below the required version.

Fixed: required mods that are not yet installed on the device are now detected and queued for install on startup (previously only already-installed mods were checked). Banner now shows in red for required installs, lists + for new installs vs arrows for updates, and cannot be dismissed while required mods are missing.

Download buttons for versions below minVersion are now disabled on both the website and the in-game version history — you can no longer manually install an outdated version that would be immediately force-updated.

Added minVersion enforcement: mods below the minimum required version are flagged in red as REQUIRED regardless of auto-update setting, and are automatically queued for update. Added CompareVersions() semver comparator.
Fixed: correctly notifies CNRMod when the overlay is opened/closed so CNRMod hides its mail and settings buttons. Adds public OpenWindow() entry point for CNRMod's multiplayer dialog.

Per-mod auto-update toggle. Startup background update check with badge counter. Update banner with one-tap batch update. Green toast notifications. Version detection with 3-tier fallback. Fixed checkbox rendering. CNRModManager itself is now self-updatable.
Initial release. Browse tab with mod list and detail pages. Version history with changelogs. latestOnly flag per mod. Multiple repo support with PlayerPrefs storage.
